{{Quote|Aaahh!|Guard screaming as Starkiller launched him into melted ore|<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>}}
This '''unnamed Shadow Guard''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Emperor's Shadow Guard]]. He was stationed on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] at the [[Imperial Ore Facility]]. He was killed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] apprentice [[Galen Marek]] when he [[Second mission to Raxus Prime|stormed]] the facility and dueled the guard.

==Biography==
At some point, he became a member of the [[Emperor's Shadow Guard]], an elite subdivision of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]]. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], he was stationed at the [[Imperial Ore Facility]] on the junk [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], spending his time in the ore cannon control room. However, [[Galen Marek]], the secret apprentice of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], [[Second mission to Raxus Prime|infiltrated the facility]] and mowed down the garrison of [[Imperial Navy commando]]s, [[Imperial Heavy Trooper/Legends|Imperial heavy troopers]], [[Jumptrooper/Legends|Imperial jumptroopers]], and [[Imperial medic/Legends|Imperial medics]]. reaching the ore cannon control room, the two engaged in a duel. Marek won, and sent the guard flying into a ball of melted ore using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

==Powers and abilities==
As a Shadow Guard, he was proficient with a [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pike]], using it in the duel. The Guardsmen also was able to use the Force to some extent, producing purple [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and able to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|Force choke]]. In the end, his skills were no match for that of Marek's.

==Behind the scenes==
This Shadow Guard is only present in the Wii and PS2 versions of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''. In the PS3 and Xbox 360 versions, Galen Marek instead fought a malfunctioning [[PROXY]] who utilized battle data for the Shadow Guard.
